storyCards.headline: Baby Baby: A Cultural Moment Captured on Record
storyCards.fact:
Corona's "Baby Baby" reached #57 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Baby Baby" is a song by Italian band Corona, released in February 1995 by ZYX Music as the second single from their debut album, The Rhythm of the Night (1995).

The song peaked at #57 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 17 weeks on the chart.

Baby Baby was released in 1995.
